cards.body: IMD's Chennai forecast shows highs of about 35°C, cloudy skies and light rain this week, with thunderstorms on Wednesday and Thursday.
El Niño hurt the southwest monsoon, but IMD says it usually has no major negative effect on northeast monsoon rain.

cards.why: The northeast monsoon is Chennai's main rainy season, and IMD says it is about to arrive.

hook: Chennai's *big rain season* is almost here. Are you ready?

learn.t: IMD says this year's southwest monsoon ended 12.6% below normal, mainly because of El Niño.
